headline: Leap Partners Expands Into Virginia With Acquisition of 360 Plumbing Service
summary: Leap Partners expanded its home service operations into Virginia by acquiring 360 Plumbing Service in the Richmond area.
why: Consolidation in the fragmented home services sector via strategic acquisitions drives regional market expansion for private equity-backed operators.

impacts.name: Leap Partners
impacts.why: Geographic expansion broadens the company's service footprint.
